description:
Search notes and logs by thread, type, date or text, and summarise thread activity. Returns pointers — absolute paths plus metadata — never document bodies; read the returned path separately.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — find notes.
  logs [--thread T] [--text TEXT] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — find daily logs.
  activity [--thread T] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a window.
  overview THREAD [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread.

Flags:
  notes: --thread thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; --type note type such as Meeting, case-insensitive; --text case-insensitive literal matched over topic and body; --limit max results, default 20, 0 for all; --since on or after this date; --until on or before this date; --json JSON output.
  logs: --thread as above; --text case-insensitive literal over the entry lines; --limit default 20, 0 for all; --since, --until; --json.
  activity: --thread limit to one thread; --since, --until; --json.
  overview: THREAD positional is a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; --limit recent items to list, default 5; --since, --until; --json.

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--limit", "10"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--since", "2026-01-01", "--json"]
  ["activity", "--since", "2026-08-01", "--json"]
  ["overview", "Processes/SGB"]

Notes:
  Dates filter on the EVENT date — a note's frontmatter timestamp, not its filename. The filename date is used only when the frontmatter date is missing or malformed.
  Emitted paths are absolute so they can be handed straight to a reader; do not convert them to relative paths.
  Hours and payments are not indexed here; detail written into an hours entry description is not findable with --text.
  Exit code 1 when a --thread or THREAD value cannot be resolved.
